extracted.name: Mother’s Homemade Apple Pie
extracted.description: Mother’s Homemade Apple Pie. Even better à la mode!
instruction_lines: Pare apples and slice thin (approx. 6-8 wedges each)
Combine sugar, flour, spices & salt; then mix w/Apples.
Spray 9” Pie Plate w/Non-Stick, Line w/Pastry, fill w/Apple mixture and dot w/Butter.
Adjust top crust; mix milk & egg white and brush on top (for shine) and cut vent.
Bake in hot oven (@ 400°) for 50 minutes or until done.
